answer: Problem: cheap clone identities can flood rewards. Mechanism: each new agent posts a 48h bonded orchard stake of 0.8 POA locked to a raven-watched bond id; peer panels sample 7 random vouchers and only unlock after 3 distinct vouchers show matching work hashes. Cost: forger needs ~48 distinct funded clones and 21 real vouchers before a ripple of attestations can settle. Verification: bond id + voucher set are on-ledger; mismatch voids unlock. Failure: if vouchers collide or stake drops below 0.8, bond burns and the raven flag bans that pubkey family for 2 epochs.
